reference_sql:
SELECT s.store_code, c.category_name
FROM stores s
CROSS JOIN categories c
WHERE s.country_code = 'BE' AND c.parent_category = 'Gaming'
alternatives: SELECT s.store_code, c.category_name FROM categories c CROSS JOIN stores s WHERE c.parent_category = 'Gaming' AND s.country_code = 'BE'
SELECT s.store_code, c.category_name FROM stores s, categories c WHERE s.country_code = 'BE' AND c.parent_category = 'Gaming'

other_way.sql: SELECT s.store_code, c.category_name FROM stores s, categories c WHERE s.country_code = 'BE' AND c.parent_category = 'Gaming'
other_way.tradeoff: Listing both tables with a comma gives the same pairs, but CROSS JOIN tells the reader that every pair is meant.

planted_wrong.sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.store_code, c.category_name FROM stores s JOIN orders o ON o.store_id = s.store_id JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE s.country_code = 'BE' AND c.parent_category = 'Gaming'
SELECT s.store_code, c.category_name FROM stores s JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = s.store_id WHERE s.country_code = 'BE' AND c.parent_category = 'Gaming'
